Method of Attack: Improper validation of incoming UPnP traffic allowing unauthenticated attackers to restart vulnerable devices or execute arbitrary code remotely as root
Discoverer: Quentin Kaiser of IoT Inspector Research Lab
Impacted Systems: Cisco Small Business RV110W, RV130, RV130W, and RV215W Routers
Attack Vector: UPnP service enabled on LAN interfaces of affected routers
Indicators of Compromise: No public proof-of-concept exploits known for CVE-2021-34730
